producer_report.summary: Added one bullet to the planner prompt and one to the critic prompt. A plan step that calls an external service (GitHub API, CI run, deploy) must now name the state it needs (for example, a run completed) and how the plan checks or waits for it. The critic must raise a major finding in round one when a plan omits this. A new unit test, `external_service_calls_need_a_named_state_and_a_wait`, asserts the key wording in both frames. To keep each frame under 500 estimated tokens I cut the closing "structured output" line from both prompts and shortened the snapshot sentences and one planner clause. I also updated the planner and critic lines in docs/system-facts.md and added a CHANGELOG entry. All of `cargo test --locked` exited successfully, and fmt, clippy and the policy scan are clean.

mistakes: My first planner trim left planner.md at 1498 bytes, one over the 1497 limit. I shortened 'before any code is written' to 'before any coding' to fix it.
I tried to filter the full test output with a pipe and then read the saved output file; both were blocked by Athena's policy. I had to judge the full run from its exit status alone.
learnings: The frame limit is estimate_tokens(frame.text) < 500, which is ceil(bytes/3), so a frame may be at most 1497 bytes.

system_facts_budgets_match_computed and system_facts_drift_is_rejected in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs fail whenever a planner or critic prompt size changes, until the lines in docs/system-facts.md are updated.
Bash in the producer role cannot use pipes or grep, and tool output saved outside the working directory cannot be read back.
desires: A way to read the saved output of a long test run inside the working directory, or a quiet cargo test mode that prints only failures.
